title: unified-rollouts: add canary/A-B/shadow telemetry and autorollback observability
author: Aisha Gupta
description: Motivation: rollout workflows (canary, A/B, shadow) have limited telemetry surface which makes diagnosing why automatic rollbacks trigger or do not trigger difficult. This PR adds structured telemetry hooks and dashboard-friendly metrics for rollout stages, decision points, and rollback reasons. It also enriches the autorollback engine with observability tags so we can correlate Linear/Jira incidents with metric triggers and request samples. Changes include: 1) emit rollout_stage events with attributes (rollout_id, model_version, stage_type, weight, traffic_pct, duration_ms, region, customer_tier) 2) emit decision_trace events whenever an autorollback decision is evaluated (metrics evaluated, thresholds compared, quorum info) 3) attach sample request IDs and representative prompt hashes to rollback events for privacy-preserving debugging 4) add lightweight histograms for per-stage latency and error-rate distributions and counters for model-fallbacks and shadow-probing outcomes 5) expose telemetry toggles (sampling rate, enable_full_trace) and guard rails to avoid high-cardinality explosions. Work done: implemented instrumentation in the rollout controller and autorollback engine, added a new telemetry serializer to the control-plane event bus, added integration points to the Console for a rollout timeline view, and added e2e tests that assert telemetry emitted for canary/AB/shadow transitions. Checklist: - [x] rollout controller instrumentation - [x] autorollback decision traces - [x] sample request linking (pseudonymized) - [x] telemetry config + rate limiting guards - [x] Console timeline UI integration (backend endpoints + small frontend panel) - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] added docs snippet and changelog entry Notes: kept default sampling low (0.1) to avoid overhead for small tenants; full tracing can be enabled per-customer in Dedicated/Private. Non-blocking: will follow-up with Grafana dashboards and alerting playbook for SRE. See linked Linear items for rollout acceptance criteria.

Default sampling low; configurable per-customer. Improves diagnosability of autorollback behavior.
